name: axenta-erp-crm-suite
description: Axenta Business Consulting ERP + CRM + Employee Management platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -n FRONTEND,BACKEND -c blue,gold "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npm run dev --prefix backend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix backend
scripts.start: concurrently -n FRONTEND,BACKEND -c blue,gold "npm run start --prefix frontend" "npm run start --prefix backend"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix backend
